highlights: Green Lion GPS Pro Smart Watch
The Green Lion GPS Pro Smart Watch features the perfect blend of style and functionality for an easy-to-use digital experience.
This 1.6" AMOLED display comes with a high resolution of 480 x 480 for impressive visuals and a brightness of 1000 nits for maximum visibility in any light.
It has a stylish zinc alloy watch case offering durability.
It has features like BT 5.3 for seamless connections, heart rate monitoring, a sleep tracker, TWS function, and voice recording.
It allows for BT calls and even plays local music, while the STK8327 G-sensor tracks movement reliably.
You'll even enjoy access to the phone album, geomagnetic readings & altitude monitoring.
A large 450mAh will give up to 6 days of active use and 15 days of standby.
The Green Lion GPS Pro Smart Watch is 5 ATM water resistant and makes this smartwatch an excellent fit for an active lifestyle.
